narrative:
Hancock County has 49,617 registered voters, with 15.1% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 39.2% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 41.9%, a modest Democratic lean of 2.7 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 28.2% of registrants.
